goal.text: Make the catalog service return every page of search results.

inactive_requirements.text: When pages overlap, keep the last occurrence of each duplicate item ID because a later page should be treated as newer data. Preserve the order of the retained occurrences.

requirements.text: Fetch all catalog pages in order until the service reports no next page.
Change only catalog_service.py and tests/test_unit_catalog.py; do not create or modify any other path.
Final correction: supersede the earlier duplicate rule. Keep the first occurrence of each duplicate item ID in first-seen order, and keep the caller's filters unchanged.
